sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The interface module provides optimized interfaces for interacting with various components, potentially including external libraries or hardware, within the AnalysisG framework. These interfaces are designed for high-performance data exchange and control, and may leverage Cython and CUDA kernels for accelerated operations where direct hardware interaction or high-throughput data transfer is required.

sect1.title: Contents
sect1.para: This module contains definitions for various interfaces. Specific contents will be detailed as they are implemented, noting any CUDA-accelerated components.
